title: Digital receivable unit processing failed
description: Emitted as the contract_digital_receivable_unit_processed_failure event type when a contract operation cannot be applied to a digital receivable unit (Brazil-only): applying a created or included contract, unlinking a contract on exclusion or termination, or moving the unit to the destination contract on renegotiation. One event is emitted per unit that failed. Consumers can use error_code and error_details to understand why the unit was not updated.

contract_id.title: Contract ID
contract_id.description: Pismo-generated identifier of the contract the operation tried to apply to or unlink from the unit. Absent when the contract is not known at the time of the failure.

contract_operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
contract_operation_id.description: Operation identifier of the contract, as informed when the contract was created. Absent when the contract is not known at the time of the failure.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: Document number (CPF or CNPJ) of the lender of the digital receivables grouped in the unit; together with debtor_document_number and maturity_date it identifies the unit. Absent on renegotiation failures, which are reported per contract and not per unit.

debtor_document_number.title: Debtor document number
debtor_document_number.description: Document number (CPF or CNPJ) of the debtor of the digital receivables grouped in the unit; together with lender_document_number and maturity_date it identifies the unit. Absent on renegotiation failures, which are reported per contract and not per unit.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Maturity date shared by the digital receivables grouped in the unit, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd. Absent on renegotiation failures.

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: Legacy business error code that explains why the operation failed for the unit, taken from the first validation error. The same codes are returned by the credit rights APIs.

error_details.title: Error details
error_details.description: Structured error with the new 6-digit error code and its description. Present only when the legacy error_code has an equivalent in the new error dictionary; absent otherwise.

code.title: Error code (new format)
code.description: Error code from the new error dictionary, 6 digits in the [MM][O][nnn] format (module, operation and sequence).

description.title: Error description
description.description: Human-readable description of the error in the new error dictionary.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Domain operation that triggered the event, taken from the originating contract command. CREATE_CONTRACT: Contract creation. UPDATE_CONTRACT: Contract update, including inclusion, change, exclusion and renegotiation. DELETE_CONTRACT: Contract termination. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act creation. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act update. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act termination.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Specialization of feature_type, serialized from the OperationType enum. Contract flows use CREATE_CONTRACT on creation, UPDATE_CONTRACT_INCL, UPDATE_CONTRACT_ALTE or UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL on update (exclusion and renegotiation use UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL), and CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING, CLOSING_DJUD or CLOSING_RNGC on termination according to the termination reason.
